result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it provides up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, requires machine-readable data return within 30 days of Customer's request, and preserves secure deletion and written certification thereafter. The revision appropriately replaces only the contradictory immediate cut-off/deletion language while retaining the more protective existing data-return and deletion provisions. The added expiry and Order Form references are reasonable scope clarifications and do not disturb unrelated commercial terms.
